name: 7.1 Headphone Surround
author: Flubsound
description: Set the game (and the Flubsound Game device) to 7.1: the Headphone Virtualizer renders all eight channels binaurally, with side and rear speakers spread for clear front, side and back separation, a little room for out-of-head sound and a tamed LFE. Use either the game's own HRTF with a stereo output or this preset, never both.
